source.note: Character select is not in Interface.xdat. Local control rects come from OnCreate/OnPaint. Screen anchors come from the lobby builder at 0x1017D410, which calls SetPosition (vtable +0xC0) and then stores an anchor with vtable +0xD0. The anchor is the position that survives a resize: the resolver at 0x1005C570 lines the window's anchor point up with the parent's and adds the stored offset. Anchor enum matches the xdat Alignment list (1 TOP_LEFT ... 9 BOTTOM_RIGHT).

screenPlacement.anchorMethod: 0x1005D950 (vtable +0xD0) stores mode at +0x138, x at +0x150, y at +0x154
screenPlacement.resolver: 0x1005C570 adds (stored - selfAnchor + parentAnchor) to the window origin

NCLobbyWnd_CharInfo.evidence: SetPosition(0x18, 0x1B, 0x100, 0x6C) then anchor mode 1, x=0x18, y=0x1B at 0x1017D466

NCLobbyStartWnd.evidence: SetPosition pre-correction x=screenW/2-0x47, y=screenH-0x6F, 0x8C x 0x31, then anchor mode 8, x=0, y=-10 at 0x1017D5B2

NCLobbyFunctionWnd.evidence: SetPosition pre-correction x=screenW-0x9A, y=screenH-0xC8, 0x78 x 0x8A, then anchor mode 9, x=-34, y=-10 at 0x1017D661
